title: API keys
adminsOnly: Only admins and owners can manage API keys.

list.title: Your keys
list.intro: Keys let your own software read and change queues. Each key has only the permissions you give it.

queues_read.name: Read queues
queues_read.help: See queues, their state and who is waiting.

visits_read.name: Read visits
visits_read.help: See visits and their status. Guest names and contact details are never included.

visits_write.name: Change visits
visits_write.help: Add guests and call, serve or remove visits.

analytics_read.name: Read analytics
analytics_read.help: See wait times and volume numbers.

webhooks_manage.name: Manage webhooks
webhooks_manage.help: Add and remove webhook endpoints through the API.

create.title: Create an API key
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: What the key is for, e.g. Front desk display.

shown.title: Copy your key now
shown.description: This is the only time the full key is shown. We keep only a fingerprint, so a lost key cannot be recovered; create a new one instead.
shown.label: Your new key

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.description: Anything using this key stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid_input: Check the name and expiry and try again.
errors.permission_denied: Only admins and owners can create keys.
errors.not_found: That organization or location was not found.
